De Iusta Haereticorum Punitione (Alfonso de Castro, 1549)
==========================================================
Castro's 1549 three books on the just punishment of heretics; the Spanish Franciscan's legal theology of persecution. Public domain. Digitized from Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/per_witchcraft-in-europe-and-america_-de-iusta-haereticoru_castro-alfonso-de-d-1_1549_206).
